title: onboard-aurora-lite-5b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sana Kapoor
description: Onboard Aurora-Lite 5B v1.0: add metadata, performance profiles, and wire up changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Aurora-Lite 5B is a sparsely-quantized variant targeting low-latency hosted and dedicated deployments; adding it to the model registry enables clients to select this low-cost option and allows the runtime to pick optimized kernels. This PR includes: 1) model metadata JSON (architecture, tokenizer, fingerprint, recommended quantization profiles), 2) perf profiles for common sequence lengths and batch sizes derived from perf lab runs, 3) automated changelog entry generation hook so the registry changelog is updated on merge, 4) docs snippet for supported variants. Checklist: - [x] validate checksum and model manifest - [x] attach compatibility tags (onnx, kv-cache=true) - [x] perf profile verified on g5.12xlarge and dedicated 80GB A100 setups - [x] unit/integration tests for metadata parser - [x] changelog automation test (dry-run). Rollout: registry entry will be enabled behind a feature flag (model_registry.enable_aurora_lite) for the initial canary. Backwards compatibility: existing model selection logic falls back to aurora-5b v1.0 when the lite variant is not applicable. See linked Linear ENG-4128 for the onboarding plan and perf benchmarks.
